Faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before you start

q1.q: Who are the mentors on Connectus?
q1.a: Mentors are applicants and graduates of top universities worldwide who went through the admissions process themselves and now help others do the same. Many are Bolashak, Chevening, DAAD, and other scholarship recipients. Every mentor is vetted and authenticated — only carefully selected, competency-checked candidates work on the platform.

q2.a: The first consultation is a get-to-know-you call where you discuss your goals and plan. Mentors set their own prices for services, and you see the full cost upfront. No hidden fees.

q3.a:
The applicant sends the mentor a consultation request. The mentor can accept or decline — for example, if they already have a lot of active applicants. Once accepted, a chat opens right on the platform, and all communication stays inside Connectus.

An important note on safety: all discussions should stay on the platform. If you exchange personal contacts (phone, messengers, email) and work outside Connectus, we can't take responsibility for the quality of the work and won't be able to help if a dispute comes up.

q4.q: What if the mentor isn't the right fit?
q4.a: The first consultation is a get-to-know-you call. If you feel the mentor isn't the right fit, you're free to choose someone else.

q5.q: Why is Connectus useful for parents?
q5.a:
Applying abroad involves hundreds of details: choosing a country and university, exams, essays, deadlines, grants, visas. Figuring it all out alone is nearly impossible, and a single mistake can cost a year — or your child's dream.

Connectus gives you direct access to people who've already walked that path — graduates of MIT, Oxbridge, TU Munich, Bolashak and Chevening scholars. They'll tell you how it really works, help build a plan tailored to your child, and save you months of searching for information online.

MentorGuide.title: Mentor guide
MentorGuide.subtitle: 4 things worth knowing before applicants start reaching out.
MentorGuide.footer: Questions? Message support — we're happy to help with your first setup.

s1.title: Intro call — make it yours
s1.p1: Every mentor automatically gets an "Intro call" service from the platform. It's a get-to-know-you meeting — its main goal is getting the applicant to book more of your services afterward.
s1.p2: You set the price and duration yourself — anywhere from 0 to 200,000 ₸, 5 to 240 minutes. The cheaper and shorter it is (e.g. 5,000 ₸ × 15 minutes), the more applicants will try it — it's a funnel play.
s1.p3: Edit it under "My services" → the "Edit" button on the intro-call card.

s2.title: Fill in your schedule — without it, students can't book
s2.p1: A student books a specific slot on your calendar. If your schedule is empty, the "Book" button won't work.
s2.p2: Set the days and hours you're available for consultations. Slot length adjusts automatically to match the duration of whatever service the student is booking.
s2.p3: List a window you can actually keep, not "always available" — a cancelled meeting is worse than a no-show student.

s3.title: How much you earn, and how
s3.block1desc: The platform's commission (30%) is added on top — nothing is deducted from the price you set. Set your service at 20,000 ₸ and you get all 20,000 ₸; the student pays 26,000 ₸ including the commission.
s3.block4desc: The payment gateway isn't integrated yet — we transfer money manually (Kaspi / bank) after an order is completed. Without payout details on your profile, the platform doesn't know where to send the money, and it'll sit stuck in "To be paid". Fill in the "Payout details" field on your profile page if you haven't already.

s4.title: Other services — your next step in selling
s4.p1: After the intro call, applicants see your other services — essay review, admissions support, visa help, and so on. What you offer and for how much is entirely up to you.
s4.p2: Prices range from 0 to 1,000,000 ₸, duration from 5 to 480 minutes. The platform takes a 30% fee.
s4.p3: Add them in the same place — "My services", the "+ Add" button.
